newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources pays $5.4 mln for centers.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources pays $5.4 mln for centers.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said Tuesaday that it has acquired three diagnostic imaging centers located in New York City for $5.4 million in cash and stock, plus the assumption of $5.3 million of debt.
The centers' annual revenues are about $7 million, said the company, which added that it expects the transaction to be immediately accretive to per-share earnings.

Medical Resources owns, operates and manages 82 diagnostic imaging centers, and through its subsidiary, StarMed Staffing, provides temporary healthcare staffing to acute and sub-acute care facilities.
